div.div: بَلَدٌ بَقِلٌ and ↓ مُبْقِلٌ [A country, or region, or district, producing plants, or herbs, of the kind termed بَقْل. (JK.) And أَرْضٌ بَقِلَةٌ, (Msb, K,) [in the CK بَقْلَةٌ, but it is] like فَرِحَةٌ, (TA,) and ↓ بَقِيلَةٌ and ↓ مُبْقِلَةٌ , (JK, Msb, K,) Land producing بَقْل: (Msb:) or producing plants, or herbage: (K:) and the first and ↓ second of these, (K,) and ↓ بَقَّالةٌ , erroneously written in the copies of the K بَقَّالَةٌ, without teshdeed, (TA,) and ↓ مَبْقَلَةٌ and ↓ مَبْقُلَةٌ , (K,) land having, or containing, بَقْل (K, * TA) of [the rain, or season, called] the رَبِيع: (K:) or ↓ مَبْقَلَةٌ [used alone, as a subst.,] signifies a land having, or containing, بَقْل; (JK;) or a place of بَقْل: (S:) and ↓ بَاقِلٌ [app. as meaning producing بَقْل] is applied as an epithet to a place; (JK, Msb;) but not ↓ مُبْقِلٌ ; (JK;) or this last sometimes occurs, thus applied. (IJ, IB.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
